invalidWorkspace: The writing response has no valid document.
sharedWorking: Shared working screenplay · saving does not confirm production or generate media.
sharedSnapshot: Shared immutable snapshot · create another draft to edit.
privateScope: Private to you · not a production source until explicitly adopted.
wordCountRule: CJK characters plus Latin words; punctuation excluded. This is not a token or duration count.
serverSaveRequired: Save to the server before this action. Resolve recovery, conflict or sign-in first.
duplicateTab: This manuscript is also open in another browser tab. Server conflict checks remain authoritative.
authLost: Upload stopped: access or sign-in changed. Download this identity’s unsaved draft before switching accounts.
conflictExplanation: The server did not accept all changes. Compare both copies and preserve your draft before resolving; no force retry will run.
stateSaveFailed: Not saved — server and local recovery unavailable
baselineLegacy: Legacy baseline · original content not retained
versionExplanation: Versions are immutable shared text snapshots. Private drafts and production baselines are separate.
shareSnapshot: Share only this selected manuscript with the production
previewSafety: Only selected frozen actions will apply. Text changes do not generate media or replace existing takes.
candidatePreserved: Your editable adaptation candidate is saved as draft {{id}}.
stalePreview: This preview is stale, expired or already applied. Create a fresh preview.
manualOverride: Director override detected — replacement requires explicit selection.
mediaPreserved: Existing media and candidate history will be preserved; old-script media may need review.
actionRemoveScene: Remove this selected scene, preserve shots
actionRemove: Remove scene boundary and text, preserve shots
keepDeviceMetadata: Explicitly keep device chapter structure and lens choices instead of the server metadata
impactUnavailable: Story impact is unavailable until its server contract is aligned and validated. No impact request has been sent.
undoStale: The manuscript changed after this structure edit. Undo cannot overwrite subsequent work; compare the saved before-version instead.
localRecoveryFailed: Device recovery is unavailable. Keep this page open or download the draft until the server acknowledges it.
existingTake: Existing take · may use an earlier screenplay
sourceDevelopmentHelp: These private choices affect an explicit adaptation preview, never the original prose or production framing.
chapterHelp: Select paragraph blocks to define at most two levels. Moving a chapter moves its original blocks; removing a boundary keeps the prose.
chapterBlocks: Paragraphs for this chapter or section
loadConflictBase: Load current server copy for merge
mergeExplanation: Only checked device blocks replace the displayed server blocks. Unchecked blocks keep the current server copy. A further server change will conflict again.
recoveryExplanation: Compare before restoring. A changed server base requires conflict resolution; device content is never uploaded automatically.
